results.label: the tree RECORDED all three criteria on an ordinary trade: the link, the checklist and the explicit acknowledgement — the facts the exercise counts were never missing
the tree ships the rep count (clean-reps-v1) exactly when the count is the delivered one
the analytics payload carries a rep count exactly when the tree serves it, and the parent serves NONE: one eligible trade, zero keys
and the count the delivered tree serves is derived from those recorded rows rather than from a stored number: with an unset start it refuses to report a figure at all
the settings route stores the trader’s two declarations exactly when it knows them, and the parent silently drops BOTH keys
so on the parent tree there is nowhere at all to declare either: the exercise cannot even be STARTED, which is the first half of the fault
the card exists as a shipped file exactly when the tree renders it
and it is MOUNTED exactly when it renders: the dashboard calls it, and on the parent the call-site count is zero
the page loads the card’s script exactly when it renders, so the mount cannot be a missing script
the parent’s goal concept is a money target (`profit_target_pct`) and it is untouched here: the rep count adds a habit count beside it rather than redefining it
and the count it adds is a count of TRADES: the only day-shaped thing it exposes is labelled as information in the module itself, and days are never the measure
no tree here has a challenge/rep table: the declarations live in the settings object and the count is derived, which is why the parent needs no migration
and in the delivered tree the ONLY writer of a declaration is the settings route the trader already owns — no endpoint of the count’s own, and on the parent, zero call sites
